instruction_reference: User response to the presented first English/French card drafts and source evidence; IDE context has the English card open.
reviewer_attribution: User in the current chat; no separate verified account UUID or signer identity supplied.
accepted_scope: The first-card English/French Markdown draft set and source evidence presented immediately before this response, at the exact hashes below.
review_detail: The user reports review and acceptance. No individual factual/language/accessibility test results, separate reviewer identity or independence from a future publishing operator are inferred.
artifact_preservation: Accepted Markdown bytes are preserved unchanged, including their original draft/pending-review labels. Those labels describe the drafting state; this record establishes subsequent user content acceptance. These are not a signed production bundle.
remaining_publication_requirements: Prepare the final safe rendered/plain-text publication artifact using the accepted content baseline; record any presentation/conversion delta and re-review changed wording.
Bind the actual reviewer identity and authority, with a distinct publishing operator, to the final artifact.
Record the final-page accessibility checks required by the approved process.
Record verification/review-due dates, validate the actual review signature and perform authorized publication checks.
Reverify source details before each demonstration and after known service changes; follow the approved 30-day formal review cadence.
